descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S28 Two patients in one context: a status or a template pick never carries over to the next patient opened (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U9 The physician still sees the template picker at Generate and can change the pre-selected template by hand; changing the template does not change the badge, and Generate writes the note in the templat … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Two Hospital patients A and B and two residents A and B, all untouched

When Hospital: set A to Consult and change Note Format by hand to Discharge summary; back to the list; open B. Set B to New Admission and change Note Format by hand to SOAP progress; back; open A. Nursing Home: set resident A to Consult and change Note Format by hand to SNF admission; open resident B; …

Then B opens as Follow-up with SOAP progress / SNF follow-up pre-selected (its own status's template, not A's status or A's pick); A is still Consult after B's change and never shows B's New Admission or B's template

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 'the badge can be changed by hand at any time' (per patient) + 'the badge only pre-selects' + TFA-92584 AC 1, 6. useNoteFormats keeps picks in a module-level Map keyed by the row id and reads it once per mount (useState initializer), so a chart reused for the next patient is the failure mode. …

Where it ran: dev unit U15; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
